_comment: The exact bundles every number in README.md and CHANGELOG.md is quoted from. evals/run.sh re-derives every cell from these directories with the frozen scorer on every gate run and asserts the solution arm against the bar below; the rules/baseline cells are re-derived and printed, not independently asserted. The two mean_case_* ceilings are set at 2x the observed pooled mean of the solution bundle ($0.1807/case, 44.1s/case): run-to-run drift of a 12-case mean was +-15% across the three committed runs, so 2x cannot fire on noise, while a systematically 2x-costlier or slower agent fails the gate even at 36/36.
